== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later [[Imperial Squad Leader (Errata)|Errata]] / [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC Errata)|PC Errata]] articles of this family. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0). Appendix A repeats that Glossary text and is not a PC Errata column. [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC Errata)]] redirects here. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, ESB Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
